changes.comment: Add restoreTranscript(snapshot) to /transcript: it gives a Transcript model with summarize(), prompts(options), mainAgentId(), promptStarts(lane?), shadowed() and toSnapshot(). The plain transcript type is now TranscriptSnapshot: loadTranscript and SessionAdapter.load resolve to it, and code that annotates their values as Transcript must rename the annotation to TranscriptSnapshot or restore the model. Runtime output is unchanged.
